responsibility: Implements a dynamically growing indexed storage structure that maps CARDINAL indices to arbitrary addresses, with bounds tracking, resizing, deletion, membership checks, and simple foreach traversal. The FIO and other runtime modules use it as a general-purpose handle table; its responsibility is managing index-to-pointer storage and growth semantics, not string interning, trees, or list ordering.
same_name_distinction: This file implements the indexed storage mechanism itself, including the concrete Indexing__T2 layout, dynamic growth via reallocation, element insertion/removal, bounds checks, and iteration. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GIndexing.h, it contains the mutable array representation and algorithms rather than just the opaque API.
